body:

Working:

```
for i in range(start, len(array)):
    temp = array[i-start+1:i+1]
    temp = (temp - temp.min())/(temp.max() - temp.min())*2-1
    out[i] = np.arctanh(temp[-1]) 
```

title: Dead Kernel WSL Debian on np.arctan()
